description: Use the Growth Rate Chart to enhance a line and column chart by adding extra relative or absolute column (growth) comparisons. Ideal for time series to compare e.g. same month/day in different years/months. Extended formatting options for the chart and comparisons. Interactive functions (adding labels and selecting comparisons) for the users. Some formatting and actions require the activation of the premium features of the Growth Rate Chart that is available for a one-time price and a free-of-charge renewal.
